paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual‑use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi‑step agentic workflows, data pipelines and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment.

I have built end‑to‑end agentic pipelines using Python and PostgreSQL, integrating CI processes that keep stakeholders informed at each stage. My work routinely automates the coordination of tool execution and prompt chaining, delivering reproducible results while adhering to strict AI Infrastructure standards. This experience aligns directly with the requirement for llm, agentic and GitHub Actions expertise, demonstrating my ability to operationalise complex LLM services in production.

I have applied machine‑learning techniques to evaluate model performance, employing XGBoost and R for propensity modelling and hyperparameter tuning. This work produced reliable evaluation metrics that inform ongoing optimisation of AI systems. By focusing on rigorous evaluation, I satisfy the requirement for evaluation and machine‑learning competence, ensuring that deployed models maintain accuracy and cost‑effectiveness over time.
